paragraphs: He is mentioned in Megillah, chapter 1, beginning of halakhah 9; R' Zeira reports in his name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: רה״ט is conventionally read as beginning of halakhah 9; the old note omitted beginning. The source does not name the Talmud, and a Yerushalmi-style format is not independently verified edition mapping.
Both heading Imi and body Zeira have abbreviated titles, retained as R'. Zeira reports in the contextual heading subject’s name, without a further identity binding.
